profile: Optional local HBUI fonts from installed Bedrock 1.26.6005.0
distribution: Metadata only. Original font binaries remain in ignored local cache, outside Git/public/npm. Local site builds can embed them when enabled.

optionalMedia.distribution: Ignored local cache and local preview only; not Git/public/npm.

boundaries: The public package keeps its open-font fallbacks; these families are optional host resources.
The local preview registers unchanged OpenType bytes and applies the Chinese fallback only through DeathScreen font tokens.
Font identity does not by itself certify native glyph rasterization, platform antialiasing, baseline or spacing.
